notes: XP15 stage A: a binary fire/smoke gate for the XIAO ESP32-S3, trained off-device. Recall is stratified by plume size and never pooled, because a gate that only sees obvious flame fires when the fire is already obvious. The decision rule was fixed before the run: port only at <=5% false wakes with >=0.70 recall on small plumes. Tiny plumes are measured but excluded from the rule, since 96 px almost certainly cannot reach them and a bar nobody can clear proves nothing. No model_id: this is not a detector and does not belong in the detector tables.
